rounds.notes: malformed round #1: the round is a LIST, so it is not an integer lane-round identity and cannot even be used as a dict key. The entry names no lane-round, so its lane row is held out of the status ledger; lane_rounds annotates and never re-keys.
malformed round #2: the round is a DICT, likewise not an integer lane-round identity and unhashable as a raw dict key.

malformed round #3: the round is null AND the entry carries no `lanes` map at all. Both defects are independent, so BOTH must be reported: the entry-missing-lanes contradiction and the unknown_round finding. The unknown_round finding must not be swallowed by the missing-lanes path.
the valid sibling row: (kagi, 1) stays a status row and keeps its ok status beside the three malformed entries.
